a.lede: CEO Mark Zuckerberg kicked off the company’s annual Connect event in Menlo Park on Wednesday with a keynote that made one thing clear: Meta is going all-in on Muse. It's even coming to Meta's AI glasses.
a.title: Everything new coming to Meta’s AI agent Muse

b.lede: Meta is building a dedicated hardware device for its new Muse AI agent.
